name: This Is Not an Escape
summary: You wake up in a field. You have no memory of who you are or how you got there. How cliche. It's a nice enough place. There are trees, a pond, a road... and a fellow on a bike coming down that road. Maybe he'll have some answers. Maybe he won't. But you know you just can't stay here... This Is Not An Escape is an interactive movie adventure by Something's Awry Productions. It's a slow paced, artistic kind of work that uses YouTube as its medium, as much as film or gaming.
